title: Spyglass: Elevating Your Insights
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, a powerful new tool designed to help you unlock deeper understanding and make more informed decisions.

title: Effortless File Management and Enhanced Display in Your Editor
summary: We've introduced powerful new tools that give you unparalleled control over managing and displaying all your files and images directly within the editor, making content creation smoother and more precise.

title: Unveiling the Noeko Public Roadmap
summary: Get a clear view of our journey with the new public roadmap, detailing recently shipped updates, what's coming next, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've rolled out bigger, more responsive checkboxes that are now fully draggable, making task management more intuitive and visually cohesive with the rest of your experience.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly upgraded our collaboration tools, making it easier and more intuitive than ever to work seamlessly with your team in real-time.

title: Enhanced Shared Content & Collaboration
summary: Now you can effortlessly find and collaborate on shared items with your connections, making teamwork more seamless and productive.

title: Empowering Your Vision: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to open Noeko's codebase, providing our community with ultimate control and the ability to directly shape the platform's exciting future.

title: Expanded Language Support
summary: Get ready for a truly global Noeko experience as we introduce comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages.

title: Elevated Theme Experience
summary: Get ready for a visual upgrade as we enhance our existing themes and introduce a vibrant collection of brand-new designs.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map: Advanced Filtering & Sharing
summary: Explore your knowledge base and connect with shared insights like never before, thanks to powerful new filtering and social visibility features in the Constellation view.

title: Unlock Your Insights: Advanced Search & Custom Collections
summary: Experience a more powerful search that lets you filter, sort, and save custom knowledge collections, making it easier than ever to pinpoint and revisit your most valuable insights.

title: Transforming How You Connect Ideas
summary: Discover a powerful new way to view and interact with linked content directly within your notes, helping you organize and explore your thoughts with unprecedented clarity.

title: Noeko: Host Your Way, Unlock New Potential
summary: Get ready for Noeko's official launch, empowering you with flexible self-hosted deployment options and powerful new paid plans designed to unlock advanced capabilities.

title: Personalized Time-Based Welcome
summary: We're making your app experience even more personal by ensuring your homepage greeting always accurately reflects the time of day.

title: Enhanced Tag Management Actions
summary: Gain powerful control over your tagged items with new in-list actions, allowing you to quickly remove, delete, or view them directly from any tag.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: Now you can effortlessly integrate and interact with a wider range of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to enrich your knowledge base.
